verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents 8 B200 GPUs with 1,440 GB total GPU memory in a single DGX B200 node, about 180 GB per GPU. That is ample capacity for a 70B-class quantized model on a single node. The product is positioned for LLM inference with a claimed 15X inference uplift, and a community commenter on LLM inference benchmarks rates B200 well above H200. Missing for 10: per-GPU HBM memory bandwidth (only the 14.4 TB/s NVLink interconnect figure is given), an explicit per-GPU VRAM figure, and any hands-on 70B-class quantized inference results.
